title: The Best Job in the World

vocabulary.meaning_en: the work you do to get money
a person who makes new machines or things
a person who helps sick people
vocabulary.example: A doctor works in a hospital.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a big red truck for firefighters
vocabulary.example: The fire engine is in the garage.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a hard hat that keeps your head safe
a very big area of salt water
water that falls from the sky

vocabulary.example: It was very cold on the boat.

vocabulary.meaning_en: feeling you want to vomit; ill
not interested; nothing fun to do

vocabulary.example: I am going to be an author.
What do you want to be when you grow up?

fine_lines.title: bored vs boring
fine_lines.explanation_ar: bored يصف شعورك (أشعر بالملل)، و boring يصف الشيء الممل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "bored" is how you feel. "boring" describes the thing.

expressions.phrase: What do you want to be when you grow up?
expressions.meaning_ar: ماذا تريد أن تصبح عندما تكبر؟
expressions.example: What do you want to be when you grow up? - A doctor.

expressions.phrase: I'm not going to be a trawler worker!
expressions.meaning_ar: لن أكون عاملة على سفينة صيد!
expressions.meaning_en: Saying no to a future plan.
expressions.example: It's cold and wet. I'm not going to be a fisherman!

expressions.phrase: This is the best job in the world.
expressions.meaning_en: Saying a job is the very best.
expressions.example: I love books. This is the best job in the world.

grammar.title: I want to be + a job / I am going to be + a job
grammar.explanation_ar: نتحدث عن المستقبل: I want to be a doctor (رغبة)، I am going to be an author (خطة). نستخدم a أو an قبل الوظيفة.
grammar.explanation_en: Talk about the future: I want to be a doctor. I am going to be an author. Use a/an before the job.
examples: I want to be a teacher.
I am going to be an author.
She wants to be a firefighter.

grammar.title: Past simple: was / were and -ed verbs
grammar.explanation_ar: القصة في الماضي. نستخدم was مع I/he/she/it و were مع you/we/they. والأفعال المنتظمة نضيف لها ed: look → looked.
grammar.explanation_en: The story is in the past. Use was (I/he/she/it) and were (you/we/they). Regular verbs add -ed: look → looked.

questions.question: What did the firefighter do in the movie?
questions.explanation_en: He cleaned and polished metal things.

questions.question: Why did Elli stop the trawler movie?
choices: She felt sick and it was cold.
questions.explanation_en: She felt sick; it was cold and rainy.

questions.question: In the end, Elli wants to be an ___.
questions.explanation_en: She wants to be an author.

questions.question: A person who writes books is an ___.
Nothing fun is happening. I am ___.
What do you want to be when you ___?
Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I want to be a doctor.
questions.explanation_ar: الصحيح I want to be a doctor.
questions.explanation_en: Correct: I want to be a doctor.

questions.question: Firefighters ride in a ___.
questions.explanation_en: Firefighters ride in a fire engine.

questions.question: "sea" in Arabic is ___.
questions.explanation_en: The sea is big salt water.
